# Rohith Illuri

> Self-taught developer. Portfolio is a single static HTML page with a dark antiquarian aesthetic — no frameworks, no build step. Motto: *facta non verba* — deeds, not words.

## About

Rohith is a self-taught developer who likes shipping things, performance work, and clean UIs. He works across the stack — React on the front, Node/Python on the back, PostgreSQL for state, Docker/AWS to run it. Outside of code: heavy lifting, AC/DC at unreasonable volumes, and Tarantino films.

## Site

Deployed at https://rohithilluri.github.io — a single `site/index.html` file. Pure HTML/CSS/JS, no React, no bundler, no third-party runtime except Tone.js (generative background audio, gesture-gated).

Structure: four numbered parts — I · The Works, II · The Craft, III · The Muses, IV · The Letter.

## Projects

- **Crave** — a food-ordering marketplace covering ordering, fulfilment, and delivery. Stack: React, Node, PostgreSQL.
- **CryptoApp** — real-time crypto markets rendered as they move; streaming prices, live charts. Stack: React, WebSocket.
- **Toronto** — the city read through its open data; patterns surfaced from the civic record. Stack: Python.
- **NNets** — neural networks built from first principles, no framework — only the mathematics. Stack: Python, Micrograd.

Source for all: https://github.com/rohithIlluri

## Skills

JavaScript · React · Node.js · Python · PostgreSQL · Docker · AWS · GraphQL · Neural Networks (from scratch)
